reference.description: Existing archived multi-provider consensus, copied byte for byte; this baseline is not independent publisher gold.

coverage.qualityCoverage: Full-document headline scores require all pages. Failed and incomplete models have no invented quality score; successful page evidence remains private.

evaluation.referenceTextScope: Existing archived multi-provider consensus; not independent publisher gold.
evaluation.structureAccuracyUnavailableReason: Text-only OCR does not establish cell assignment, row/column mapping, spans or blank-cell geometry. Numeric/text presence is not table-structure accuracy.
evaluation.lexicalMetricLimitation: Headline WER/CER use the existing case-insensitive lexical normalization and declared reference order. Reading-order or serialization differences can increase edit distance; these scores do not measure layout or exact glyph/punctuation fidelity.
evaluation.fidelityMetricLimitation: Literal numeric, punctuation and whitespace comparisons are representation-fidelity diagnostics. TSV tabs, span-continuation blanks, Markdown wrappers and source case conventions can differ without establishing a recognition error.

serializationPolicy: Existing agent-authored multi-provider consensus copied byte-for-byte; original JPEG bytes reused as a distinct run without modifying historical results.
